evidence.source: Paper section 2.2 and SI synthesis identify oPmPCZ, formula C44H28N4, and CCDC deposition 2466817.

Paper section 2.3 and the SI theoretical-calculation paragraph describe an optimized isolated-molecule ground state followed by excited-state calculations; the public task independently chooses the workflow.

Paper Fig. 2c and section 2.3 identify the scientific objects S1, T1, T6, and T7, but do not provide source-readable standalone numerical energies for all four; evaluation therefore checks reported energies, units, and assignments rather than inventing targets.
Paper section 2.3, page 3, reports calculated S1-T1 gap 0.93 eV (ev_doc_cd513d66b81f_000070_f7263fcc5718).
Paper section 2.3, page 4, reports SOC(S1,T6)=0.362, SOC(S1,T7)=0.215, and SOC(S1,T1)=0.073 cm^-1.
Paper section 2.3 interprets higher-triplet energetic proximity and larger SOC as supporting hRISC feasibility, while the observables do not establish a rate or unique mechanism.
